controversies.title: Ratable Base Balance & Budgetary Oversight (West Milford Township)
controversies.entityInvolved: West Milford Township Municipal Administration & Tax Assessor
controversies.summary: Encompasses 80 square miles in the Highlands water protection zone. With 92.4% residential ratables and minimal commercial base, single-family homeowners bear nearly the entire school and municipal levy.
controversies.investigationDetails: Annual review of municipal tax appeals and school district funding allocations under Passaic County Board of Taxation guidelines.
controversies.taxpayerImpact: Affects composite property tax millage and municipal equalized ratables.
